---
title: "Our Team"
page-layout: full
toc: false

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The team page is built from TWO "listings". A listing automatically scans a
# folder and turns each member file into a card.
#
# We split current members from alumni BY FOLDER (one folder per group):
#   - current-members -> members/current/*.qmd
#   - alumni-members  -> members/alumni/*.qmd
# Each member file lives in exactly ONE of these folders, so the two grids
# never overlap. To retire someone, move their .qmd from current/ to alumni/.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
listing:
  - id: current-members
    contents: "members/current/*.qmd"
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 4            # smaller cards -> 8 current members fit in 2 rows
    # No image-height: the portraits are square-cropped and theme.scss renders
    # the card image 1:1 (see ".quarto-grid-item .card-img-top"). A fixed height
    # here would letterbox them back into short cards.
    fields: [image, title, subtitle]
    image-placeholder: /images/portraits/placeholder.svg
    sort: "weight asc"         # order by the `weight:` field (PI first, etc.)
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false

  - id: alumni-members
    contents: "members/alumni/*.qmd"
    type: table              # compact text list, no photos
    fields: [title, details]  # `details` is a hand-written one-line summary per person
    field-display-names:
      title: "Name"
      details: "Details"
    sort: "sort_key desc"     # most recent departure first; sort_key: 0 = unknown, sorts last
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false

# Drives the lab-photo gallery below. This page only, loaded after the markup.
format:
  html:
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="/js/lab-gallery.js" defer></script>
---

We are an interdisciplinary group working at the interface of ecology, Earth
system science, and remote sensing.

**Join us!** We welcome undergraduate researchers, prospective graduate students,
and postdocs. Reach out to [Xiangtao](mailto:xx286@cornell.edu) if our work
resonates with you.


<!--
  Lab group photos, newest first. The gallery holds the newest photo for 10 s,
  then flips through the older ones at 3 s each and wraps around (timings live
  in js/lab-gallery.js).

  To add a photo: crop it to 1.4:1, save it as images/lab/lab-<year>-<month>.jpg
  at 1600 px wide plus a -800.jpg for phones, and paste a new <figure> at the
  TOP of this list — moving the `is-active` class onto it, since that slide is
  the one the gallery starts on and the only one visible without JavaScript.
-->
<div class="lab-gallery" role="region" aria-label="Lab group photos through the years">
  <figure class="lab-gallery__slide is-active" data-label="August 2026">
    <img src="/images/lab/lab-2026-aug.jpg"
         srcset="/images/lab/lab-2026-aug-800.jpg 800w, /images/lab/lab-2026-aug.jpg 1600w"
         sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 880px"
         width="1600" height="1143"
         alt="The BioM2 Lab group photo, August 2026">
    <figcaption class="lab-gallery__caption">August 2026</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <figure class="lab-gallery__slide" data-label="May 2024">
    <img src="/images/lab/lab-2024-may.jpg"
         srcset="/images/lab/lab-2024-may-800.jpg 800w, /images/lab/lab-2024-may.jpg 1600w"
         sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 880px"
         width="1600" height="1143"
         loading="lazy"
         alt="The BioM2 Lab group photo, May 2024">
    <figcaption class="lab-gallery__caption">May 2024</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <figure class="lab-gallery__slide" data-label="Fall 2023">
    <img src="/images/lab/lab-2023-fall.jpg"
         srcset="/images/lab/lab-2023-fall-800.jpg 800w, /images/lab/lab-2023-fall.jpg 1600w"
         sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 880px"
         width="1600" height="1143"
         loading="lazy"
         alt="The BioM2 Lab group photo, Fall 2023">
    <figcaption class="lab-gallery__caption">Fall 2023</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <figure class="lab-gallery__slide" data-label="Fall 2022">
    <img src="/images/lab/lab-2022-fall.jpg"
         srcset="/images/lab/lab-2022-fall-800.jpg 800w, /images/lab/lab-2022-fall.jpg 1600w"
         sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 880px"
         width="1600" height="1143"
         loading="lazy"
         alt="The BioM2 Lab group photo, Fall 2022">
    <figcaption class="lab-gallery__caption">Fall 2022</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <div class="lab-gallery__dots"></div>
</div>
